units.title: SG-10.1 Keyboard handling in the Phaser scene with typed events
Act: Add focusChange and menuClose to PhaserToReactEvents
Act: Add keyboard handler to BootScene.create and release it on shutdown
Act: Subscribe App to menuClose to clear the selection
Verify: focusChange and menuClose events deliver payloads

tests.name: delivers focusChange payload to a subscribed handler
tests.title: phaserToReact keyboard events: delivers focusChange payload to a subscribed handler
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed to focusChange, When focusChange is emitted with {id:'bookshelf'}, Then the handler is called with that exact payload
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: menuClose unsubscribes: no delivery after the returned unsubscribe is called
tests.title: phaserToReact keyboard events: menuClose unsubscribes, no delivery after the returned unsubscribe is called
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed to menuClose and one emit delivered, When unsubscribe is called and menuClose is emitted again, Then the handler has been called exactly once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: delivers a phaser-to-react event payload to a subscribed handler exactly once
tests.title: typed event bus delivery: delivers a phaser-to-react event payload to a subscribed handler exactly once
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed to objectClick, When objectClick is emitted, Then the handler is called once with that payload
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: stops delivering events after the returned unsubscribe function is called
tests.title: typed event bus delivery: stops delivering events after the returned unsubscribe function is called
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed to objectClick and the first emit delivered, When unsubscribe is called and objectClick is emitted again, Then the handler is still called only once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: delivers characterClick payload once and not to objectClick handlers
tests.title: typed event bus delivery: delivers characterClick payload once and not to objectClick handlers
tests.scenario: Given characterClick and objectClick handlers, When characterClick is emitted with {id:'boy'}, Then only the characterClick handler is called, once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: delivers no events to react-to-phaser handlers after clear is called
tests.title: typed event bus delivery: delivers no events to react-to-phaser handlers after clear is called
tests.scenario: Given a transitionTo handler on the react-to-phaser bus, When the bus is cleared and transitionTo is emitted, Then no handler is called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: keeps the event bus free of any direct phaser import
tests.title: typed event bus delivery: keeps the event bus free of any direct phaser import
tests.scenario: Given src/phaser/events.ts on disk, Then it does not import from 'phaser' directly
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: BootScene keyboard unit tests for each key with Phaser mocked

tests.name: registers a callable keydown handler on the keyboard plugin during create
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > registers a callable keydown handler on the keyboard plugin during create
tests.scenario: Given BootScene.create has run, When the keyboard plugin is inspected, Then a keydown handler is registered and callable

tests.name: moves focus forward and emits focusChange with the focused object id when Tab is pressed
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > moves focus forward and emits focusChange when Tab is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the scene has one focused object, When Tab is pressed, Then moveFocus is called with (objects, 1), preventDefault is called, and focusChange emits {id:'bookshelf'}

tests.name: moves focus backward when Shift+Tab is pressed
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > moves focus backward when Shift+Tab is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the scene has one focused object, When Shift+Tab is pressed, Then moveFocus is called with (objects, -1) and focusChange emits {id:'bookshelf'}

tests.name: moves focus backward when ArrowLeft is pressed
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > moves focus backward when ArrowLeft is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the scene has one focused object, When ArrowLeft is pressed, Then moveFocus is called with (objects, -1)

tests.name: moves focus forward when ArrowRight is pressed
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > moves focus forward when ArrowRight is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the scene has one focused object, When ArrowRight is pressed, Then moveFocus is called with (objects, 1)

tests.name: forwards Enter to the focused object handleKey
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > forwards Enter to the focused object handleKey
tests.scenario: Given a focused object, When Enter is pressed, Then handleKey is called with 'Enter' and focus does not move

tests.name: forwards Space to the focused object handleKey
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > forwards Space to the focused object handleKey
tests.scenario: Given a focused object, When the space key is pressed, Then handleKey is called with ' ' and focus does not move

tests.name: emits menuClose to React when Escape is pressed
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > emits menuClose to React when Escape is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the scene is running, When Escape is pressed, Then phaserToReact emits menuClose with {} and focus and handleKey are not called

tests.name: removes the same keydown handler from the keyboard plugin when the scene shuts down
tests.title: BootScene keyboard > removes the same keydown handler from the keyboard plugin on shutdown
tests.scenario: Given create registered a SHUTDOWN callback via events.once, When that callback runs, Then input.keyboard.off is called with ('keydown', the registered handler)

units.title: Verify: menuClose closes the ActionMenu and unsubscribes on unmount

tests.id: appMenuClose.test.tsx › App menuClose › closes the ActionMenu
tests.name: App menuClose closes the ActionMenu on menuClose
tests.title: Given an object is selected, when menuClose is emitted, then the ActionMenu closes and its buttons disappear
tests.scenario: Given the playing view with bookshelf selected via objectClick, when menuClose is emitted, then Inspect/Push/Search/Leave are absent
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appMenuClose.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appMenuClose.test.tsx › App menuClose › unsubscribes on unmount
tests.name: App menuClose unsubscribes from menuClose on unmount
tests.title: Given App is unmounted, when it unsubscribes from menuClose, then the menuClose listener is released and no error is logged
tests.scenario: Given App subscribed to menuClose, when unmounted, then the returned unsubscribe is invoked once and a later menuClose emit logs no console error
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appMenuClose.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

units.title: REQ · Typed focusChange and menuClose events exist on the Phaser to React bus
REQ · BootScene maps Tab, arrows, Enter, Space and Escape to focus, select and close events
REQ · App closes the ActionMenu on menuClose and keeps it open on selection
Evidence: Keyboard events, BootScene keys and menuClose unit tests pass
